verdict.rationale: HeyGen documents an official MCP server, with a probe confirming the docs page at developers.heygen.com/mcp/overview. Its docs say any MCP-compatible agent can connect to HeyGen video generation with no API keys or local server, and that every endpoint ships with an MCP server for Claude, Cursor and custom agents. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents connecting, and detailed tool-list and setup documentation in the pack.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: Connect HeyGen video generation to any MCP-compatible AI agent — no API keys, no local server, no separate credits.
Every endpoint ships with an MCP server, llms.txt, and typed schemas — so Claude, Cursor, and your own agents can generate video without glue code.
